history.summary: IDENTITY FLAG: no authoritative web source pins down a 'Radha Madhab Temple' in Jalpaiguri town. The best candidate is 'Radha Madhab seba asram', listed in a place directory as a Hindu temple in Jalpaiguri district (~7.5 miles south of Jalpaiguri town, approx. 26.4655, 88.6321) — but it has no official page or reviews, so this match is provisional. Excluded referents: the well-known Radha Madhab Temple at Bishnupur, Bankura (1737, eka-ratna, ASI Monument of National Importance) is NOT this row; a 'Radha Madhab Temple' is also listed at Alipurduar (736121) and there is a Radha Krishna Temple at Vivekananda Pally, Balapara near Teesta Bridge, Jalpaiguri. District literature mentions a 'Radha Madhab Temple' as the district's Vaishnava presence without details. COORDINATE FLAG: map geocoder could not resolve this site — coordinates below are from a directory listing and are provisional. Treat this file as an identity-unconfirmed placeholder.
